# pve_node_suspendall (Action)

Suspend all guests on a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_suspendall" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_suspendall.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximal number of parallel migration job. If not set, uses'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg, and if that's not set the available'
                    .' CPU threads, clamped to a maximum of 8, are used.
- `vms` (String) Only consider Guests with these IDs.
